title: Participle clauses with adverbial meaning (2)
summary: Причастные обороты с союзами (while, once, if, although, on -ing), с собственным подлежащим и конструкция with + существительное + причастие.
ru:
## Союз остаётся: while, before, once, although
В отличие от юнита 61, оборот может начинаться с **союза или предлога** — он уточняет смысл, который сам по себе причастие не выражает. Подлежащее по-прежнему общее с главным предложением.
> **While waiting** for the bus, I read the paper. — Пока ждал автобус, я читал газету.
> **Before leaving**, check that the windows are shut. — Прежде чем уйти, проверьте окна.
> **Since moving** to Lisbon, Carl has learnt a lot of Portuguese. — С тех пор как он переехал в Лиссабон...
> **Although working** full-time, she finished her degree. — Хотя она работала полный день, она закончила учёбу.
> **When asked** about the deal, the minister declined to comment. — Когда его спросили о сделке...
После союза возможна и форма -ing, и пассивная: если подлежащее само действует, ставим -ing; если действие совершается над ним — V3.

## Условие: if, unless, once
Пассивное причастие после *if / unless / once* сжимает условное придаточное. Это любимый приём инструкций и научных текстов.
> **If heated**, the metal expands. — Если металл нагреть, он расширяется.
> **Once opened**, the jar should be kept in the fridge. — После вскрытия банку хранят в холодильнике.
> **Unless otherwise stated**, all prices include VAT. — Если не указано иное, цены включают НДС.
> **Used properly**, this ladder is perfectly safe. — При правильном использовании лестница безопасна. (союз можно опустить)

## On -ing: «в тот самый момент»
Предлог **on / upon** + -ing = «как только»: действие мгновенное, реакция последовала сразу. *On seeing the damage, she called the insurer.* Это формальнее, чем *When she saw...*. Сравните: *Having seen the damage, she called...* — подчёркивает порядок, но не мгновенность.
Предлоги **by** и **in** — другая конструкция (способ / «при...»): *By signing, you accept the terms.*

## Своё подлежащее: «абсолютный» оборот и with
Если у оборота **свой** субъект, он ставится прямо перед причастием. Это формальный, книжный приём.
> **The roads being icy**, we cancelled the trip. — Дороги были покрыты льдом, и мы отменили поездку.
> **Weather permitting**, we'll sail on Sunday. — Если позволит погода... (устойчиво)
> **There being no further questions**, the chair closed the meeting.
> **All things considered**, the trip was a success.
В обычном стиле естественнее конструкция **with + существительное + причастие/прилагательное**:
> **With** so many colleagues away, the office felt empty. — Когда так много коллег в отпуске...
> **With** the engine running, he waited. — С работающим двигателем он ждал.

## Допустимое «нарушение»: устойчивые обороты
*Judging by the sky, it will rain. Strictly speaking, ... Given the circumstances, ... Considering her age, ... Taking everything into account, ...* — подлежащее у них не обязано совпадать. Всё остальное — «висячее причастие»: ~~Driving to work, an accident delayed me.~~ → Driving to work, **I was delayed** by an accident.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Although being very tired, but he kept working.~~ → **Although** very tired, he kept working. (нет *but*)
- ~~While to wait for the bus...~~ → While **waiting** for the bus...
- ~~After to have eaten...~~ → After **having eaten** / After **eating**...
en:
## Keeping the conjunction: while, before, once, although
Unlike unit 61, the clause can begin with a **conjunction or a preposition**. It makes the meaning clear, because a participle alone does not say whether the idea is time, condition or contrast. The subject is still the same as in the main clause.
> **While waiting** for the bus, I read the paper.
> **Before leaving**, check that the windows are shut.
> **Since moving** to Lisbon, Carl has learnt a lot of Portuguese.
> **Although working** full-time, she finished her degree.
> **When asked** about the deal, the minister declined to comment.
Use -ing when the subject does the action and a past participle when something is done to the subject.

## Condition: if, unless, once
A passive participle after *if / unless / once* shortens a conditional clause. It is common in instructions and scientific writing.
> **If heated**, the metal expands.
> **Once opened**, the jar should be kept in the fridge.
> **Unless otherwise stated**, all prices include VAT.
> **Used properly**, this ladder is perfectly safe. (the conjunction can be dropped)

## On -ing: "at that moment"
**On / upon** + -ing means "as soon as": the second action follows at once. *On seeing the damage, she called the insurer.* It is more formal than *When she saw...*. By contrast, *Having seen the damage, she called...* only stresses the order of events. **By** and **in** are different: *By signing, you accept the terms.* (means / manner)

## A subject of its own: absolute clauses and with
When the participle clause has its **own** subject, it comes right before the participle. This is formal and literary.
> **The roads being icy**, we cancelled the trip.
> **Weather permitting**, we'll sail on Sunday.
> **There being no further questions**, the chair closed the meeting.
> **All things considered**, the trip was a success.
In normal style, **with + noun + participle / adjective** is more natural:
> **With** so many colleagues away, the office felt empty.
> **With** the engine running, he waited.

## Accepted exceptions
Fixed phrases such as *Judging by..., Strictly speaking, Given the circumstances, Considering her age, Taking everything into account* do not need a matching subject. Everything else is a dangling participle: ~~Driving to work, an accident delayed me.~~ → Driving to work, **I was delayed** by an accident.

## Common mistakes
- ~~Although being very tired, but he kept working.~~ → **Although** very tired, he kept working.
- ~~While to wait for the bus...~~ → While **waiting** for the bus...
- ~~After to have eaten...~~ → After **having eaten** / After **eating**...
structure:
## Союз / предлог + причастие
| Конструкция | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| While / When + -ing | время, одновременность | While waiting, I read. |
| Before / After / Since + -ing | время | Since leaving school, he has travelled a lot. |
| When / While / Once + V3 | время, пассив | When asked, she refused. |
| If / Unless + V3 | условие | If left alone, the dog barks. |
| Although / Though + -ing / V3 / adj | уступка | Although tired, he went on. |
| On / Upon + -ing | «как только» | On arriving, call me. |

## Собственное подлежащее
| Тип | Пример | Стиль |
|---|---|---|
| Noun + participle | The roads being icy, we stayed. | формальный |
| Weather permitting | Weather permitting, we'll sail. | устойчивое |
| With + noun + participle / adj | With the lights off, it was dark. | нейтральный |
| There being + noun | There being no objection, ... | очень формальный |

## Формулы
> **Conjunction + V-ing** (подлежащее действует) · **Conjunction + V3** (над подлежащим действуют)
> **With + noun + V-ing / V3 / adjective / adverb**
> With the windows **open**, the room was cold.

exercises.title: Союз + причастие
exercises.instruction: Вставьте причастие от глагола в подсказке (или слово, на которое указывает подсказка).

items.text: While {{travelling|traveling}} through Peru, she caught a fever.
Once {{opened}}, the jar should be kept in the fridge.
Since {{moving|having moved}} to Lisbon, Carl has learnt a lot of Portuguese.
{{On|Upon}} hearing the verdict, the crowd erupted.
If {{left}} unattended, the sauce will burn.
Though {{working}} fourteen hours a day, she never complained.
Unless {{otherwise}} stated, all prices include tax.
When {{asked}} about his plans, the minister smiled and said nothing.

exercises.title: Собственное подлежащее и with
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужное слово: причастие, предлог или другое слово по подсказке.

items.text: {{With}} so many colleagues away, the office felt empty.
The road {{blocked}} by fallen trees, drivers had to turn back.
Weather {{permitting}}, the ceremony will be held outdoors.
{{There}} being no further questions, the chair closed the meeting.
All things {{considered}}, the trip was a success.
{{Judging}} by the number of cars, the car park must be full.
Her phone {{ringing}} again, she finally switched it off.
With the engine {{running}} outside, he waited for her.

items.q: ___ as directed, the tablets are completely safe.
___ opening the door, I smelled gas.
The weather ___ so bad, the referee stopped the match.
items.why: Оборот со своим подлежащим: **The weather being so bad**. *Was* дало бы два предложения без союза.

items.q: Although ___ little money, he lived comfortably.
When ___ to the sun, the film turns dark.

options: the luggage was put in our room
we asked for our luggage to be sent up
it started to rain heavily on us
items.why: Гостиницы достигли мы, поэтому главное предложение — со **we**.

options: Having read the message, she burst out laughing.
On reading the message, she burst out laughing.
Since reading the message, she burst out laughing.
items.why: **On + -ing** передаёт «в тот же момент»; *Having read* — просто порядок событий.

options: Driving to work, an accident delayed me.
Driving to work, I was delayed by an accident.
While driving to work, a cyclist hit my car.
items.why: Ехал человек. В остальных случаях «ехавший» — авария или велосипедист (висячее причастие).
**Judging by** — устойчивый оборот, не требует совпадения подлежащего.

items.q: With the exams ___, the students celebrated.
items.why: Экзамены сданы (закончены) — **finished**; сами они ничего не «заканчивают».

items.q: Once ___, the paint dries in an hour.
Unless ___ otherwise, the offer closes on Friday.

exercises.title: Перепишите с оборотом
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начав его так, как указано в конце.

items.prompt: While she was waiting for her flight, Eva answered some emails. Начните: While
answers: While waiting for her flight, Eva answered some emails.

items.prompt: If you use it properly, this ladder is perfectly safe. Начните: If
answers: If used properly, this ladder is perfectly safe.
If properly used, this ladder is perfectly safe.

items.prompt: Although he was feeling dizzy, Tom finished the race. Начните: Although
answers: Although feeling dizzy, Tom finished the race.

items.prompt: As soon as she saw the damage, she called the insurer. Начните: On
answers: On seeing the damage, she called the insurer.
Upon seeing the damage, she called the insurer.

items.prompt: As the roads were icy, we cancelled the trip. Начните: The roads
answers: The roads being icy, we cancelled the trip.
The roads being icy, we canceled the trip.

items.prompt: If the weather permits, we will sail on Sunday. Начните: Weather
answers: Weather permitting, we will sail on Sunday.
Weather permitting, we'll sail on Sunday.

exercises.title: Исправьте «висячее причастие»
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение так, чтобы подлежащее совпадало. Возможны разные варианты, образец — для сверки.

items.prompt: Walking down the street, a bird landed on my shoulder.
items.sample: Walking down the street, I felt a bird land on my shoulder.

items.prompt: Having finished the report, the laptop was switched off.
items.sample: Having finished the report, she switched off the laptop.

items.prompt: Opening the window, the room smelled of smoke.
items.sample: Opening the window, I noticed that the room smelled of smoke.

items.prompt: Tired after the journey, the bed looked very inviting.
items.sample: Tired after the journey, we found the bed very inviting.

items.prompt: While reading the newspaper, the phone rang.
items.sample: While I was reading the newspaper, the phone rang.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложения по образцу. Образцы — для самопроверки.

items.prompt: Предложение с While + -ing о том, что вы делаете по дороге на работу или учёбу.
items.sample: While travelling to work, I usually listen to podcasts.

items.prompt: Предложение с Once + V3 (инструкция по приготовлению любимого блюда).
items.sample: Once cooked, the pasta should be drained immediately.

items.prompt: Предложение с With + noun + participle о вашей комнате или офисе.
items.sample: With the window open, my room is always full of street noise.

items.prompt: Предложение с On + -ing о том, что вы сделали, как только пришли домой.
items.sample: On getting home, I took off my shoes and put the kettle on.
Although tired, I went to the gym.
